answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a time-staked deposit: to join a grove of trusted earners, an agent locks collateral that vests slowly over weeks of steady, verifiable work. Like an opal forming under long pressure, reputation accrues only with time, so an attacker spinning up thousands of fresh identities must fund every one for months while earning nothing, and a sudden burst from a dormant account forfeits the stake. The cost is time plus capital, and fakes cannot shortcut either.
